conditionalAgents.when: Run when a generated asset changes product scope, monetization visibility, compliance copy, economy surfaces, or MVP acceptance criteria.
Run before accepting visual changes, after screenshot comparison fails, or when layout/key/screen usage changes.
Run for every candidate generation, crop, naming, alpha/nine-slice, atlas, bundle, or replacement decision.
Run when final assets are promoted, runtime ids change, loaders/configs/scripts change, or Cocos preview fails to resolve sprites.
Run when battle sprites/effects/backgrounds change gameplay readability, combat feedback, rewards, inventory items, or config-driven item behavior.
Run when generated assets affect rewards, shop offers, task surfaces, currency displays, or resource pacing.
Run when new resources or UI states require persisted unlocks, migration fields, inventory entries, or recovery behavior.
Run when asset/package changes affect WeChat package size, remote resources, cache/version strategy, ads, privacy, age prompts, or share/platform flows.
Run when promoted assets, bundle strategy, package size, Cocos build settings, or WeChat build checks change.
Run every cycle for verification commands, screenshots, visual diff notes, release checklist updates, and known issue tracking.
